expectations.buyer: Plant quality, maintenance, metrology, and reliability leaders operating calibrated industrial equipment
expectations.pain: Fixed calibration intervals create downtime and cost, while extending intervals can increase measurement and compliance risk
expectations.strongestIncumbent: ISO/IEC 17025 systems, OEM guidance, calibration management software, metrology consultants, reliability methods, and accreditation rules
expectations.biggestRisk: Risk-based interval methods and incumbent calibration software may already exist, while regulated buyers may not accept algorithmic interval changes without accredited evidence
